overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to answer a April 15, 2024 request for executive session minutes within 10 days, because the request went to the Chair and fell under the OML; the Committee was ordered to comply immediately and in future.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to timely respond to a request for copies of executive session minutes for 2022-2024.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee acknowledges, and we find, that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to the April 15, 2024, request for minutes within 10 days.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the open meeting law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
